messages.author: 6d6d1fe3b03b4c64
messages.subject: Detail of gl.report.heterozygosity() function
parts:
Hi all,

I have a question about the detail of gl.report.heterozygosity() function.
I have SNPs data, which are obtained using ddRAD-seq, and I would like to calculate/estimate heterozygosity from the data using gl.report.heterozygosity().

I have various formats (all formats outputed by ipyrad; e.g, vcf, str, phy),
but all formats do not contain locus information,
so that all sites seem to be treated as unlinked. 
Assuming mutation occured at different sites of the same locus,
the locus have three alleles.
However, under such condition,
two loci which have two alleles respectively may be recognized if my data is used,
as all sites are treated as unlinked.

Here is my question:
Can gl.report.heterozygosity() calculate/estimate a correct heterozygosity under the circumstances?

Best regards,
Yasuto

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Detail of gl.report.heterozygosity() function
parts:
Hi Yasuto,

SNPs with more than two alleles are filtered out when you read/convert your data into dartR, ie. genlight objects only store bi-allelic data.

Cheers,
Luis
